description: Search the US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's public database of consumer complaints about banks, lenders, credit bureaus, debt collectors and other financial companies: find complaints by company, product, issue, state or date, read one, count them by any of these, and run a workflow when new ones are published. No account or API key required.

cfpb_complaints_new_complaint_trigger.description: Triggers once for each newly published complaint matching the company, product, issue and state you choose. The CFPB publishes complaints in batches, usually once a day, and only once the company responds or 15 days pass, so each arrives days after it was filed. Complaints already published when you turn it on never trigger it, and one batch triggers it for at most the 500 newest matching complaints
